title: OSF UI
description: OSF UI behavior and overlay presentation.

settings.label: Open / Close key
settings.hint: Press to rebind the key that opens and closes the overlay.

settings.label: Language
settings.hint: Use auto for Starfield's language, or enter a locale such as en, de, or pt-BR.

settings.label: Pause-menu entry
settings.hint: Add a MOD SETTINGS entry to the game's pause menu. Takes effect on the next launch.

settings.label: Warn about game-binding collisions
settings.hint: Show hard and possible warnings when mod hotkeys overlap Starfield's live bindings. The read-only game catalog stays visible when this is off.
